32648-the-minute-boys-of-york-town.title: The Minute Boys Of York Town
32648-the-minute-boys-of-york-town.creator: Edward Stratemeyer and James Otis
32648-the-minute-boys-of-york-town.description: A book by Edward Stratemeyer and James Otis. When Uncle 'Rasmus loses his temper because of some prank which we lads of James Town may have played upon him, he always says that no good can ever come of that in which "chillun an' women are mixed."

70506-the-family-at-misrule.title: The Family at Misrule.
70506-the-family-at-misrule.creator: Ethel Turner.
70506-the-family-at-misrule.description: A book by Ethel Turner.. LITTLE FAITHFUL MEG 254 XXIV. “IN THE MIDNIGHT, IN THE SILENCE OF THE SLEEP TIME” 266 XXV. HERE ENDETH 274 THE FAMILY AT MISRULE. “Should auld acquaintance be forgot?” There was discord at Misrule. Nell, in some mysterious way, had let down a muslin frock of last season till it reached her ankles. And Meg was doing her best to put her foot down upon it. In a metaphorical sense, of course.

72909-tumbleweeds.title: Tumbleweeds
72909-tumbleweeds.creator: Hal G. Evarts
72909-tumbleweeds.description: A book by Hal G. Evarts. Another few decades and old Joe Hinman, himself accounted a wise man among his fellows, sat his horse on a little rise of ground and lamented his own lack of foresight. Donald Carver, his younger companion, gazed off across the flat where several riders held some two thousand head of steers.

arxiv-2111-04664.title: Drag anisotropy of cylindrical solids in fluid-saturated granular beds
arxiv-2111-04664.creator: Ankush Pal and Arshad Kudrolli
arxiv-2111-04664.description: Abstract We study the direction-dependent drag acting on a cylindrical solid intruder with length L L and diameter D D as it moves in water-saturated granular beds at constant depth. Polysterene and hydrogel grains with diameter d d are used to investigate materials which have high contact friction and those which are nearly frictionless, respectively.

arxiv-2211-12440.title: A Nichtnegativstellensatz on singular varieties under the denseness of regular loci
arxiv-2211-12440.creator: Ngoc Hoang Anh Mai
arxiv-2211-12440.description: Abstract Let V V be a real algebraic variety with singularities and f f be a real polynomial non-negative on V V . Assume that the regular locus of V V is dense in V V by the usual topology.

arxiv-2305-18013.title: TReR: A Lightweight Transformer Re-Ranking Approach for 3D LiDAR Place Recognition
arxiv-2305-18013.creator: Tiago Barros, Luís Garrote, Martin Aleksandrov, Cristiano Premebida, Urbano J. Nunes
arxiv-2305-18013.description: Abstract Autonomous driving systems often require reliable loop closure detection to guarantee reduced localization drift. Recently, 3D LiDAR-based localization methods have used retrieval-based place recognition to find revisited places efficiently. However, when deployed in challenging real-world scenarios, the place recognition models become more complex, which comes at the cost of high computational demand.

arxiv-2407-17066.title: Coupled Sine-Gordon and ϕ 4 \phi^{4} System
arxiv-2407-17066.creator: Azizollah Azizi, Shaghayegh Parkami
arxiv-2407-17066.description: Abstract Coupling the fields may lead to the emergence of new phenomena. In the realm of classical fields and nonlinear systems, extensive research has been conducted on their solitary and soliton solutions. In the conducted studies, typically two ϕ 4 \phi^{4} systems, or two sine-Gordon systems, have been coupled.

arxiv-2409-03142.title: Causal Temporal Representation Learning with Nonstationary Sparse Transition
arxiv-2409-03142.creator: Xiangchen Song, Zijian Li, Guangyi Chen, Yujia Zheng, Yewen Fan, Xinshuai Dong, Kun Zhang
arxiv-2409-03142.description: Abstract Causal Temporal Representation Learning (Ctrl) methods aim to identify the temporal causal dynamics of complex nonstationary temporal sequences. Despite the success of existing Ctrl methods, they require either directly observing the domain variables or assuming a Markov prior on them.

arxiv-2410-22268.title: Numerical solution of BVP for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations at large Reynolds numbers Note: The work was supported by the Russian Science Foundation (grant No. 23-41-00037). Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2410-22268.creator: D.V. Lomasov, P.N. Vabishchevich
arxiv-2410-22268.description: Abstract The problems of numerical modeling of viscous incompressible fluid flows are widely considered in computational fluid dynamics. Stationary solutions of boundary value problems for the Navier-Stokes equations exist at large Reynolds numbers, but they are unstable and lead to transient or turbulent unsteady regimes.

arxiv-2512-07987.title: Analytical Solutions for the Dynamics of Planetary Nebulae with and without Common Envelope Evolution DOI: https://www.astroscu.unam.mx/rmaa/RMxAA..XX-X
arxiv-2512-07987.creator: G. García-Segura
arxiv-2512-07987.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by G. García-Segura. We present new analytical solutions for the dynamics of planetary nebulae. These equations consider the temporal variation of the mechanical luminosity as well as the common envelope evolution scenario. By comparing a database of nebulae with these solutions, a large portion of planetary nebulae can be better explained by the common envelope evolution scenario, especially the fast and slow ones. Single AGB stellar models can only reproduce nebulae with expansion velocities between 20 and 30 km s -1 .

arxiv-2601-19132.title: In-Network Collective Operations: Game Changer or Challenge for AI Workloads?
arxiv-2601-19132.creator: Torsten Hoefler, Mikhail Khalilov, Josiah Clark, Surendra Anubolu, Mohan Kalkunte, Karen Schramm, Eric Spada, Duncan Roweth, Keith Underwood, Adrian Caulfield, Abdul Kabbani, Amirreza Rastegari
arxiv-2601-19132.description: Abstract This paper summarizes the opportunities of in-network collective operations (INC) for accelerated collective operations in AI workloads. We provide sufficient detail to make this important field accessible to non-experts in AI or networking, fostering a connection between these communities.

arxiv-2605-16388.title: ChronoSC: Task-Oriented Semantic Communication via Temporal-to-Color Encoding
arxiv-2605-16388.creator: Phuc H. Nguyen 1 , Trung T. Nguyen 1 , Quy N. Duong 1 , and Van-Dinh Nguyen 2

arxiv-2606-23800.title: Unitary Designs from Doped Matchgate Circuits
arxiv-2606-23800.creator: Fabian Ballar Trigueros, Zheng-Hang Sun, Xhek Turkeshi, Piotr Sierant, Poetri Sonya Tarabunga

pmc-11354235.title: Identification and Expression Analysis of Sulfate Transporter Genes Family and Function Analysis of GmSULTR3;1a from Soybean
pmc-11354235.creator: Jingwen Zhou, Yue Dong, Yue Liu, Yifan Huang, Wenjing Jiang, Xiangmin Zheng, Huimin Zhang, Na Gong, Xi Bai, Hon-Ming Lam, Sachiko Isobe, Man-Wah Li
pmc-11354235.description: Sulfate transporters (SULTRs) are essential for the transport and absorption of sulfate in plants and serve as critical transport proteins within the sulfur metabolism pathway, significantly influencing plant growth, development, and stress adaptation. A bioinformatics analysis of SULTR genes in soybean was performed, resulting in the identification and classification of twenty-eight putative GmSULTRs into four distinct groups.

pmc-11653769.title: Youngia lushanensis, a new species of Asteraceae from Sichuan, China, inferred from morphology and nrITS phylogeny
pmc-11653769.creator: Yulan Peng, Xuemei Pu, Xianhua Xiong, Lijie Cheng
pmc-11653769.description: Youngia lushanensis (Asteraceae), a new species of Youngia, is described and illustrated from Lushan in Sichuan, Southwest China. Its systematic position is evaluated based on a molecular phylogenetic analysis of the nuclear ribosomal ITS and on morphological comparison with related species. It is morphologically similar to Y. purpimea and Y. szechuanica, with purplish red abaxially leaves.

pmc-12519790.title: I-ETL: an interoperability-aware health (meta)data pipeline to enable federated analyses
pmc-12519790.creator: Nelly Barret, Anna Bernasconi, Boris Bikbov, Pietro Pinoli
pmc-12519790.description: BackgroundClinicians are interested in better understanding complex diseases, such as cancer or rare diseases, so they need to produce and exchange data to mutualize sources and join forces. To do so and ensure privacy, a natural way consists in using a decentralized architecture and Federated Learning algorithms.

pmc-12579002.title: Large-scale causal discovery using interventional data sheds light on gene network structure in k562 cells
pmc-12579002.creator: Brielin C. Brown, Alex Tokolyi, John A. Morris, Tuuli Lappalainen, David A. Knowles
pmc-12579002.description: Inference of directed biological networks is an important but notoriously challenging problem. The recent proliferation of large-scale CRISPR perturbation data provides a new opportunity to tackle this problem by leveraging the transcriptional response to the presence of a gene-targeting guide. Here, we introduce inverse sparse regression (inspre), an approach to learning causal networks that leverages large-scale intervention-response data.

pmc-12830510.title: Quantitative assessment of visual designs for communicating patient-reported outcomes in breast cancer care to patients
pmc-12830510.creator: Lea Doppelbauer, Anna Maria Hage, Maria Margarete Karsten, Pimrapat Gebert, Anna Tatzber, Laura Hatzler, Jasper Brands, Rosanne Andriessen, Therese Pross
pmc-12830510.description: BackgroundPatient-reported outcomes (PROs) are increasingly recognized as valuable data to enhance communication and support shared decision-making in cancer care. Despite evidence of their positive effects, few concrete approaches exist for the design and presentation of PRO visualizations. Even in high-incidence cancers such as breast cancer, limited knowledge is available on how patients perceive and interpret graphical displays of PRO results.

pmc-13033929.title: Clinical Features of Non-Carious Cervical Lesions: An Observational Clinical Study
pmc-13033929.creator: Temitope Olabisi Omosebi, Gbenga Emmanuel Adebayo, Cynthia Osarugue Omoruyi, Temitope Elizabeth Soledolu, Kehinde Emmanuel Adebiyi, Bennett Tochukwu Amaechi
pmc-13033929.description: PurposeNon-carious cervical lesions (NCCLs) are among the most common dental pathologies observed in clinical practice. This study evaluated the clinical features of NCCLs in adult patients and assessed the relationship among age, lesion depth, dentin hypersensitivity (DHS), and sclerotic degree.Patients and MethodsA total of 78 patients were recruited, resulting in 178 teeth with NCCLs.

pmc-13194749.title: Gambling refusal self-efficacy and protective behavioral strategies mediate and moderate the relationships between impulsivity and gambling outcomes
pmc-13194749.creator: Natasa Nagy, Andrea Czakó, Zsolt Demetrovics, Zsolt Horváth
pmc-13194749.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Studies suggest that refusal self-efficacy and protective behavioral strategies may influence how impulsivity relates to addictive behaviors. However, their mediating and moderating roles have not yet been examined in the context of gambling. This study investigated whether gambling refusal self-efficacy (GRSE) and gambling protective behavioral strategies (GPBS) mediate or moderate the associations between impulsivity and gambling outcomes, including problem gambling (PG) and gambling involvement.

pmc-13225560.title: Prevalence of GJB2 gene mutations in nonsyndromic hearing impairments: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13225560.creator: Ruijie Feng, Ernest Mangantig, Wan Shahriman Yushdie Wan Yusoff, Hui Li, Xiaoze Li, Mohd Nazri Abu
pmc-13225560.description: Background:Nonsyndromic hearing impairment (NSHI) is the most common type of inherited hearing loss. Mutations in GJB2, which encodes connexin 26, are a major cause worldwide, but their prevalence and variant distribution vary across populations. To systematically evaluate the global prevalence of GJB2 mutations and 5 hotspot variants (c.35delG, c.176_191del16, c.235delC, c.299_300delAT, and c.

pmc-13278720.title: A Case of Peripartum Cardiogenic Shock Resulting From Reverse Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy
pmc-13278720.creator: Nazish Tarar, Hannah Walsh, Katherine Sadaniantz, Shantel Brissett, Anna R. Whelan, Lara Kovell
pmc-13278720.description: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy (TCM) is characterized by transient left ventricular (LV) dysfunction that classically presents as apical ballooning with basal hyperkinesis. A recognized variant, reverse TCM, conversely is characterized by basal and mid-ventricular hypokinesis with apical sparing, often triggered by a catecholamine surge.

pmc-13347541.title: A PLAN to address the Parkinson pandemic
pmc-13347541.creator: E Ray Dorsey, Michael S Okun, Bastiaan R Bloem
pmc-13347541.description: The Parkinson pandemic continues to spread. Almost 12 million individuals now have the disease, nearly double the estimate from just six years ago. Its human-made nature is also increasingly clear as more studies tie environmental toxicants to the disease. Chief among these are certain pesticides, the dry-cleaning chemicals trichloroethylene and perchloroethylene, and air pollution.

pmc-13422321.title: Gross anatomy performance associated with human cadaver dissection compared to non-cadaveric methods in nigerian medical students: a comparative cross-sectional study
pmc-13422321.creator: Willy Barinem Vidona, Collins Nduka Esomchi, Mariam Adurelere Rabiu
pmc-13422321.description: IntroductionGross anatomy forms the foundation of medical education, yet traditional cadaver dissection faces challenges from cadaver shortages, costs, and curriculum changes, prompting increased use of alternatives such as anatomical models, virtual dissection software, and textbooks. Evidence on their comparative effectiveness remains mixed, particularly in resource-limited settings.

pmc-13486662.title: Millennial clonal persistence and transposable element-biased somatic mutations in an herbaceous plant (Typha latifolia)
pmc-13486662.creator: Chichi Zhao, Ziyu Wang, Hui Zeng, Yifeng Yao, Dan Yu, Xinwei Xu
pmc-13486662.description: Clonal reproduction represents a fundamental strategy in plant propagation, enabling the formation of extensive genetically identical populations through persistent asexual growth. Understanding the spatial-temporal dynamics of these clonal systems, particularly with regard to their age, size, and somatic mutation patterns, is crucial for unravelling the evolutionary ecology of long-lived plant species.

pmc-13534581.title: 针灸治疗干预下脑梗死恢复期患者并发肺部感染的列线图预测模型构建及验证
pmc-13534581.creator: Jin Hu, Haoran Chu, Ying Wang, Chenglong Li
pmc-13534581.description: 目的分析针灸治疗干预下的脑梗死恢复期患者并发肺部感染的危险因素，并构建列线图模型。方法按照建模集与验证集7∶3比例，选择2022年1月—2024年1月期间在院内治疗的350例脑梗死患者为建模集。同时选择2024年2月至2024年12月收治的150例脑梗死患者作为验证集。收集患者一般资料、实验室指标及针灸干预变量，在建模集中使用LASSO回归筛选变量后进行多因素logistic回归，基于多因素回归结果建立列线图预测模型，分别在建模集和验证集中进行模型评价。结果脑梗死恢复期患者肺部感染发生率26.20%（131/500），其中建模集患者95例，共检出147株病原菌，以革兰阴性菌为主。建模集中，LASSO回归及logistic多因素向后逐步回归法筛选出肺部感染的危险因素为年龄增加（OR=1.043，95%CI：1.010～1.077）、进食评估问卷调查工具-10（EAT-10）评分升高（OR=1.249，95%CI：1.125～1.387）、有侵入性操作（OR=2.715，95%CI：1.340～5.501）、美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（NIHSS）评分升高（OR=2.477，95%CI：1.951～3.144）、白蛋白降低（OR=0.856，95%CI：0.786～0.931）、前白蛋白降低（OR=0.992，95%CI：0.987～0.997）、留针时间为30 min（OR=2.439，95%CI：1.146～5.191）、针灸疗程<14 d（OR=2.463，95%CI：1.157～5.243）以及发病后>3 d介入针灸治疗（OR=2.660，95%CI：1.190～5.942）。据此构建列线图模型，该模型在建模集和验证集中的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.916（95%CI：0.877～0.954）、0.923（95%CI：0.874～0.973），校正曲线证实模型预测概率与实际概率吻合度较高，应用可产生正向临床净效益。结论基于Lasso-Logistic回归构建的列线图模型能够识别针灸干预下的脑梗死恢复期患者肺部感染风险，通过量化风险因素可指导患者优化针灸治疗方案、实现精准干预，降低感染风险。Keywords: 针灸, 脑梗死恢复期, 肺部感染, 列线图, 预测模型 脑卒中是全世界第二大常见死因，每年超过600万人死于该病，近年呈现显著年轻化趋势[1]。其中脑梗死约占全部脑卒中的70%以上，我国每年新发脑梗死病例超287万，发病人数居于全球首位[2]。最新数据显示，我国60岁以上人群脑梗死患病率已达3.5 %，40-60岁人群发病率相较于十年前上升30%[3]。肺部感染是脑梗死恢复期常见并发症，在不同地区和国家发病率约2.4%～65%[4]，我国学者相关报道中[5]，脑梗死患者肺部感染发生率20%～50%不等，不仅影响神经功能恢复，还引起多器官功能衰竭、提高病死率。 现代药理学研究证实[6]，针灸可通过抑制神经炎症、改善微循环等有效改善脑梗死运动、认知以及吞咽障碍后遗症。并随着中医整体理念的发展，针灸治疗在脑梗死肺炎中也展现出独特治疗价值。相关证据表明[7]，针灸刺激特定穴位可有效改善患者免疫功能，减轻肺部炎症症状。我国为针灸应用大国，约60%的脑梗死患者接受过针灸治疗。尽管针灸在神经重症领域的应用日益广泛，但现有研究多基于西医临床指标，忽略针灸治疗参数的潜在价值，导致针灸治疗的脑梗死恢复期患者肺部感染的预测受限[8]。 本研究首次聚焦于针灸治疗的脑梗死患者这一群体，探究此类人群肺部感染现状及其危险因素，旨在识别针灸干预下的脑梗死患者肺部感染高风险人群，同时基于针灸相关参数优化临床针灸治疗方案，为针灸治疗防治肺部感染提供更具临床转化价值的工具。 对象与方法 研究对象 本研究已通过本院伦理委员会审批（伦理审批号：2021-zj-24）。样本量计算根据logistic回归样本量的EPV（events per variable）原则，EPV=10，最终共纳入研究因素9个，故需要肺部感染患者至少90例，参考李宏[9]文献中肺部感染发生率29.09%，总样本量90÷0.29≈310例。为增加结果稳健性，综合考虑后，最终纳入2022年1月—2024年1月期间在院内治疗的350例脑梗死患者进入研究，将其作为建模集。按照建模集与验证集7∶3比例，同时选择2024年2月—2024年12月期间在院内治疗的150例脑梗死患者作为验证集。纳入标准：（1）符合脑梗死诊断标准[10]，为恢复期；（2）耐受针灸治疗，治疗期间无中断；（3）年龄18～80岁；（4）具备完整临床资料。排除标准：（1）针灸治疗前已合并肺部感染；（2）合并恶性肿瘤或血液病；（3）合并严重脏器功能不全；（4）针灸治疗中断。 诊断标准 结局指标为脑梗死患者1个月内是否发生肺部感染，以患者首次接受针灸治疗的时间点作为观察起点，持续观察针灸干预后的1个月。肺部感染诊断基于临床症状、血常规检查及影像学检查，发病7d内符合以下标准中的3项即可诊断：（1）新发咳嗽、咳痰，或原有症状加重；（2）痰培养检出致病菌；（3）双肺存在不同程度肺实质体征，和（或）伴干湿啰音；（4）白细胞计数升高且体温≥37.5 ℃；（5）影像学检查表现肺部感染征象。 研究方法 搜集患者资料，包括病原菌分布情况、性别、年龄、体质量指数（body mass index, BMI）、高血压、糖尿病、高血脂、冠心病、吸烟、饮酒；病程、梗死范围、梗死部位、吞咽功能障碍〔进食评估问卷调查工具-10（eating assessment tool-10, EAT-10）〕、侵入性操作（气管插管、气管切开等）；美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（national institute of health stroke scale, NIHSS）评分[11]、格拉斯哥昏迷量表（glasgow coma scale, GCS）评分[12]；C反应蛋白（c-reactive protein, CRP）、空腹血糖、白蛋白、前白蛋白、白细胞计数和血红蛋白；中医证型、行针手法、留针时间、治疗频率、针灸疗程、针灸介入时间、穴位选择。实验室指标及相关评分均在首次接受针灸治疗时检测或评估，本研究纳入的针灸治疗方案以通督调神针刺为主，根据患者病情辨证配合项针、夹脊针、腹针等，治疗周期不低于7 d。 统计学方法 SPSS26.0分析数据，计量资料进行正态性检验，符合正态分布的以表示，组间比较采用t检验；不符合正态分布则表示为中位数（P25，P75），组间比较采用Manne Whitney U检验；计数资料表示为例数（%），组间比较采用χ2检验。使用R语言中glment包进行LASSO回归筛选重要变量，基于logistic多因素向后逐步回归法分析结果建立预测模型，rms包构建列线图并绘制受试者工作特征（receiver operator characteristic, ROC）曲线，曲线下面积（area under the curve, AUC）评估区分度，绘制校准曲线评价校准度，决策分析曲线（decision curve analysis, DCA）评价临床收益。P<0.05表示有统计学意义。 结果 肺部感染患者病原菌分布情况 建模集男性250例，女性100例，年龄（64.68±11.56）岁，BMI（22.54±2.18） kg/m2；验证集男性116例，女性34例，年龄（66.25±11.76）岁，BMI（22.54±2.16） kg/m2，两组在性别、年龄及BMI资料分布中差异无统计学意义（P>0.05）。肺部感染率为26.

pmc-13545509.title: Whole‐Brain Monosynaptic Inputs to and Axonal Projections From Posterior Insular Cortex GABAergic Neurons in Mice
pmc-13545509.creator: Wan‐Qiao Qi, Xin‐Yue Zhang, Wei‐Xiang Ma, Wei‐Min Qu, Jia‐Qi Shi, Zhi‐Li Huang, Yu‐Lan Zhu
pmc-13545509.description: BackgroundThe posterior insular cortex (PIC) is a multimodal sensory integration center, and the GABAergic neurons are associated with functions such as pain perception, emotional regulation, and fear memories encoding. However, the whole‐brain connectivity to PIC GABAergic neurons remains unclear.ObjectiveTo map the whole‐brain input–output connectivity of PIC GABAergic neurons.
